description: Move Company Tax into Operations in each year by removing the Provisions header; exclude company tax from operating contingency so yearly required budgets remain unchanged.

userEnteredValue.formulaValue:
=LET(
  available_budget, BUDGET_VALUE("available budget"),
  IF(
    available_budget = "",
    "",
    LET(
      past_payments, BUDGET_VALUE("past expenses"),
      planned_budget, BUDGET_VALUE("required budget"),
      IFS(
        past_payments > available_budget,
        "Already Over Budget",
        planned_budget > available_budget,
        "Projected Over Budget",
        available_budget = 0,
        "No Budget",
        TRUE,
        "Within Budget"
      )
    )
  )
)

after.operationsContingency:

  CASH_FLOW_PARAM_VALUES("company tax"),
  ARRAYFORMULA(YEAR(R_MONTHS)) = BUDGET_VALUE("_year")
))) * PARAM("operating contingency")
